title: Google AI Overview Kills Perplexity: The End? #shorts
description: Perplexity AI's user base plummeted 65% in 5 months, now capturing only 2% of AI traffic. Once an innovator, it's now crushed by Gemini and ChatGPT, with its unique selling point copied by competitors. Google AI Overview delivered the final blow. #PerplexityAI #AIChatbots #TechNews #GoogleAI #ChatGPT
